text: I told my baby I've been coming home Turned the first train across the Rocky Mountain range But some things you just can't know, my lord And it looks like my plans have changed Cause he had a sharp fire when the box doors opened And the borders of the drive-thru back are broken All of the folks that stayed in the train wrecked
